Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the birth years of Joseph J. Magliocco (born 1957) and Viktoriya Zeynep Güneş (born 1998), concluding that Joseph was born later, despite Viktoriya being younger. This mistake occurred in step 4 when the Planner made the final comparison based on accurate birth years provided by the WebSurfer.
